title: Westbrook beta feedback summary
text:
Author: **Tomas Rivera**, Campus Ambassador, Westbrook University
Two rounds of interviews: 12 general beta testers and 8 students from the engineering study groups.
## What students liked
- Being matched with people from the same course **section**, not just the same course
- The weekly free-time grid. Faster than coordinating in a group chat.
- The 30-minute reminder before each session (when it works)
- The "exam cram" study style, especially before midterms
- On iOS, the app feels fast
## What students didn't like
- The "about you" screen in onboarding was too long. 4 of 12 almost quit there.
- 5 testers on Android 15 never received notifications
- No way to leave a group without messaging everyone
- Groups of 5 feel too big for problem sets. 3 or 4 is better.
- The matching screen is slow on older Android phones
## Top feature requests
1. Book a library study room from the app (asked in both rounds)
2. See a group's past session times before joining
3. Choose group size
## Quotes
> "I found a calculus group in my section in like 30 seconds. That never happens."
> "I'd use it every week if I could also grab a library room."
